name: incline close grip push up with chair against wall
description: A close grip incline push-up with your hands on a chair. It is a good way to build triceps strength.
instructions: Brace a chair against a wall and place your hands close together on the seat.
Walk your feet back until your body is in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the chair, elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
